title: Decoupling the clocks of learning and computing in spiking neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.34381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biological intelligence thrives on minimal power despite its noisy, imperfect components, with neurons that communicate through voltage spikes. Brain-inspired computing seeks to bring such efficiency to real devices, which requires training methods tailored to them. The standard way to train spiking neural networks, backpropagation through time, computes weight updates through every step of a simulated device, so faithful or long simulations can make training costly and unstable. Here we show that spiking networks can learn reliably and efficiently by decoupling the clock of learning from that of computing. Our method, ChronoProp, calculates weight updates from each neuron's spike counts in fixed time bins using its measured input-output function. Compared with backpropagation through time, ChronoProp reaches similar accuracy in image classification, with about 3 times less training time and 20 times less memory at the finest timestep

translated_title: 解耦脉冲神经网络中学习与计算的时钟
translated_abstract: 生物智能尽管其组成部件嘈杂且不完美，却能以极低的功耗高效运转，其神经元通过电压尖峰进行通信。类脑计算旨在将这种效率带入真实设备中，这需要为其量身定制的训练方法。训练脉冲神经网络的标准方法——通过时间的反向传播——需要在模拟设备的每一步都计算权重更新，因此高保真或长时间的模拟会使训练成本高昂且不稳定。在这里，我们展示了解耦学习时钟与计算时钟后，脉冲网络能够可靠且高效地学习。我们的方法 ChronoProp 利用每个神经元实测的输入-输出函数，根据其在固定时间窗内的脉冲计数来计算权重更新。与通过时间的反向传播相比，ChronoProp 在图像分类任务中达到了相似的准确率，同时训练时间缩短约3倍，在最细时间步长下内存占用降低约20倍。
tldr: 本文提出 ChronoProp 方法，通过解耦学习与计算的时钟，利用神经元在固定时间窗内的脉冲计数和实测输入输出函数来计算权重更新，在图像分类中达到与通过时间反向传播相似的准确率，同时训练时间缩短约3倍、内存占用降低约20倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ChronoProp, which decouples the clock of learning from that of computing by calculating weight updates from each neuron's spike counts in fixed time bins using its measured input-output function, achieving similar image classification accuracy to backpropagation through time with about 3x less training time and 20x less memory.
